query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ii.quantity), 0.0) as "qty!: f64"
             FROM invoice_item ii
             JOIN invoice i ON i.id = ii.invoice_id
            WHERE ii.product_id = ?
              AND i.status = 'draft'
              AND COALESCE(i.voucher_no, '') = ''
              AND (? = '' OR COALESCE(ii.warehouse_code, '') = ? OR COALESCE(ii.warehouse_code, '') = '')
              AND (? IS NULL OR i.id <> ?)
